name: predictor-ops 4.2.2rc1 (SHARED-005)
body:
Pré-release de qualificação (missão crypto, D-17). Corrige a SHARED-005: no Windows, o lock local não derruba mais o processo que perde a disputa por um job novo.

- commit: 9831b0d5e727972b1d85ff48be14ffa58677898b (PR #26)
- build reprodutível: git archive + SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1758240000, 2 builds idênticos
- predictor_ops-4.2.2rc1-py3-none-any.whl sha256 82d4a33933841e2217d09a2af452f6c195bba204af6b5fa1182cecea421ec233
- predictor_ops-4.2.2rc1.tar.gz sha256 729ec7feb66d01202d0d94ef43de31870bd508b535b3f0b32d837f4ea39dceb6

name: v4.2.0
body:
## What's Changed
* docs: README e HANDOFF ainda anunciavam 4.0.0; matriz de migração marcada como plano by @leonardosovienski in https://github.com/leonardosovienski/predictor-ops/pull/19

* Require measured execution risk and serialize lease ownership by @leonardosovienski in https://github.com/leonardosovienski/predictor-ops/pull/22


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/leonardosovienski/predictor-ops/compare/v4.1.0...v4.2.0
